scope.population: Previously exposed fixed48 validation engineering records only.

interpretation: The six nonoverlapping ordinal blocks are fixed at1-8,9-16,17-24,25-32,33-40,41-48. Primary other46 excludes32/33 without closing their gaps; all48 is contextual. Each deviation retains its same-position/stage/arm six-value median from V56. Raw and strict plus/minus1ms modes are separate. Block density uses eligible block size; directional shares use the same panel/view/mode/direction total, with null shares for a zero denominator. Every maximal same-direction nonneutral run is retained; opposite signs, neutral values or excluded targets break a run, but fixed block boundaries do not. All tied longest runs and singletons remain. Blocks and run statistics are descriptions with no significance or outlier threshold, and no choice of boundaries or thresholds after viewing these segment results. Different queries and phases interleave in time; adjacent query ordinals do not establish simultaneous or sustained host load, or decoder, CPU, I/O or scheduler causality. No new experiment is run.
